name: Hormel Foods Corporation
hero_kpi_rationale: Croissance solide du chiffre d'affaires (+2%) malgré des pressions inflationnistes persistantes sur les couts des matieres premieres et les marges brutes

kpis.explanation: Total net sales of the company
kpis.signal: Revenue growth across all three segments despite volume declines
kpis.description: Net sales increased 1.6% to $12.1 billion in fiscal 2025, with growth driven by Jennie-O, SPAM, Planters, and Applegate brands
kpis._validation: yoy corrected from +2% to +1.6% per 10-K; unit corrected from Mds $ to B $; history values updated to match fiscal 2024/2025 actuals (11.92B, 12.11B)

kpis.explanation: Gross profit as a percentage of net sales
kpis.signal: Margin compression from input cost inflation offsetting T&M cost savings
kpis.description: Gross margin declined to 15.6% in fiscal 2025 from 17.0% in fiscal 2024, pressured by commodity cost inflation for pork, beef, and nuts
kpis._validation: value extracted from 10-K MD&A Gross Profit section (15.6% for FY2025); yoy calculated as -1.4 percentage points (17.0% - 15.6%); history added with fiscal 2024 prior year value

kpis.explanation: Operating income as a percentage of net sales
kpis.description: Operating margin data not separately disclosed in 10-K; operating income declined 33% primarily due to non-cash impairment charges
kpis._validation: Retained as null; while operating income is mentioned, operating margin percentage is not explicitly stated in source documents

kpis.description: R&D investments not separately disclosed; company focuses on product innovation and brand development
kpis._validation: unit corrected from % to M $; value remains null as no specific R&D figure found in source

kpis.signal: Transform and Modernize initiative driving capacity expansions and automation
kpis.description: Capital expenditures of $311 million in fiscal 2025 invested in T&M initiative, Hormel Fire Braised and Applegate capacity, technology, safety, and Jiaxing facility

stories_kpis.explanation: Expected organic net sales growth in fiscal 2026
stories_kpis.signal: Expected growth across broad categories with brand support, innovation, and market-based pricing actions
stories_kpis.description: Company expects organic net sales growth of 1% to 4% in fiscal 2026, driven by growth across categories, brand investment, innovation, and pricing actions
stories_kpis._validation: name_fr improved for clarity; last_data_date corrected to actual 10-K filing date (2025-10-26); history value updated to fiscal 2025 organic growth of 2.5% as comparable baseline

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence found in the 10-K filing.

risks.title: Cyberattaques et violations de securite
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in 10-K Item 1A as a risk to operations and sensitive data. Significant threat in food manufacturing and supply chain context. High criticality for connected industrial operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cyberattacks could disrupt operations, compromise sensitive data, or damage supply chain and manufacturing capabilities.

risks.title: Inflation des couts matieres premieres
risks.score_rationale: Repeated throughout 10-K regarding pork bellies, beef, and nut costs. Strong language indicating pressure on earnings. Direct impact on gross margin decline of 1.4 percentage points (17.0% to 15.6%). Critical for food processing sector. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Persistent commodity price inflation compresses profitability and threatens earnings growth despite revenue gains.

risks.title: Pression sur la marge brute
risks.score_rationale: Gross margin declined from 17.0% to 15.6% in fiscal 2025. Detailed analysis in MD&A shows inflation-driven compression. Strong language indicating significant impact. Existential risk for sector with structural cost pressures. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Gross margins under pressure due to production cost inflation not fully offset by pricing actions.

risks.title: Transition manageriale et instabilite de direction
risks.score_rationale: Corporate restructuring plan mentioned with workforce realignment. Strategic leadership changes implied by organizational restructuring. Transition execution risk for growth strategy and T&M initiative. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Management transitions and corporate restructuring create execution risk for strategic initiatives and growth plans.

risks.title: Dependance aux conditions macroeconomiques
risks.score_rationale: Referenced in fiscal 2026 outlook as major risk with deteriorating macroeconomic conditions impacting customers and consumers. Consumer demand sensitivity noted. Forward-looking caution evident. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Economic slowdown or consumer spending decline could negatively impact sales volume and profitability.

risks.title: Litiges juridiques et reglementaires
risks.score_rationale: Antitrust settlements referenced in MD&A with SG&A impact. Legal proceedings noted in Note K. Lower priority than inflation but present in disclosures. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Future litigation or regulatory actions could result in significant costs or operational restrictions.

risks.title: Efficacite des investissements technologiques T&M
risks.score_rationale: Transform and Modernize initiative central to capital expenditure strategy ($311M in fiscal 2025). Multi-year program expected to deliver long-term value but execution risk evident. Strategic importance for cost reduction. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Success of Transform and Modernize initiative is critical for achieving cost savings and maintaining competitive position.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
